Anatomical Reality

Why Your Current Bra May Not Fit

Bra fit depends on the relationship between your ribcage, bust volume, cup depth, wire width, and band tension—not simply a letter and number.

× Common Retail Error

  • Band can be too loose and ride up the back.
  • Straps may compensate for an unsupported band.
  • Shallow or undersized cups can create spillage and pressure.

✓ IMRango Precision Method

  • Uses the snug underbust as the primary band anchor.
  • Checks bust-to-band difference for cup sizing.
  • Considers fit symptoms and international sizing systems.

Top Commercial Brands Compared

Reference brand fit characteristics alongside your calculated size.

Open Brand Size Converter →
Panache

Panache uses UK sizing across all items. Bands are engineered firm for maximum support. If between band sizes, size up in the band.

Freya

Popular for youth and average-to-full busts. Wires are slightly softer and wider than Panache.

Wacoal

Wacoal bands tend to run snug with low stretch. Many customers prefer taking one sister size up in the band.

Victoria's Secret

Historically tends to push consumers into +4 band sizing with too-small cups. Bands stretch out rapidly; choose a snug band.

Natori

Iconic Feathers bra is very shallow at the wire. If full on bottom or projected, consider sizing up one cup size.

ThirdLove

Features exclusive half-cup sizes (e.g. B 1/2, C 1/2, D 1/2) for fine-tuned precision when between standard cups.

Aerie

Comfort-oriented fabrics with forgiving band elasticity. True to size for A-DD cups.

Skims

Designed for sculpting compression. Many users find bands run 0.5 to 1 size tight.

Elomi

Engineered specifically for plus sizes and full figures (bands 32-48, cups D-K). Excellent gore tacking and wing stability.

Curvy Kate

Vibrant designs for D+ busts. Plunges and balconies require careful cup volume checking; true UK cup progression.
